title: Remove unsolicited awareness chat and voice interruptions
head: Commit containing this receipt; published SHA and mandatory commit-guard results are recorded in the PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested feature stack on corrected F-10; keep all PRs unmerged.

baseline_review.parent_ci: Corrected F-10 head passes Tests, Docker, Windows, AppleScript and label checks.

source_review.comparison: Pinned opportunity delivery sources match current main and F-10. Existing daemon awareness auto-research and interruption paths still present before this change. Reuse the durable outbox and existing event taxonomy.

figma.visual: Backend delivery policy only; no UI behavior/layout edit or screenshot claim.

activation.requires: Installed policy; exact flag value 1 read at daemon startup. Independent of other Brief flags.

implementation: Extract legacy awareness delivery into a policy; retain default-off rollback and existing untrusted prompt framing.
Publish canonical workflow events and raw awareness notifications before the quiet gate; keep capture, evidence, goal routing and explicit subscriptions.
In quiet mode, skip automatic reactor/coalescer assistance, direct error/struggle research, proactive chat, TTS, desktop and cross-channel fallbacks.
Deliver durable opportunity card envelopes only. Return null with no accepting WebSocket, so existing receipts, leases, retries and restart recovery remain authoritative.
Register quietAwareness independently in the existing capabilities service and environment-settings inventory. Keep Authority, emergency, execution-failure and explicit-help paths.

acceptance.check: No automatic assistance or interruption for quiet error/struggle/stuck/suggestion events
acceptance.evidence: Synthetic side-effect counters, exact canonical event payload and notification assertions.

acceptance.check: Opportunity card delivery and restart recovery keep identity and receipts
acceptance.evidence: Real WebSocket transport plus file-backed offline outbox/reopen/retry; no false delivered state, chat, TTS or workflow republish.

acceptance.check: Governed signals remain visible with chat closed
acceptance.evidence: Real WebSocket client with no conversation receives approval, emergency and workflow failure with quiet mode on and off.

acceptance.check: Capture and explicit workflow subscriptions survive
acceptance.evidence: Actual AwarenessService screen event persists a capture and publishes its error; real TriggerManager queues the explicitly subscribed workflow.
Exact-value flag tests, capabilities route and legacy automatic research/delivery tests.

red.result: Legacy extraction reproduces quiet-mode failures before adding the gate.

focused.scope: Initial policy/outbox checks before capability/capture fixture additions; final versions included in affected suite.

affected.skip: Optional actual-Q13 preparation/activation integration checks require a separate dependency overlay; unchanged by F-11 and already verified on F-10.

typescript.initial_findings: The initial check caught test payload typings and early event-bus access. Corrected fixture types and deferred the bus reference until awareness starts.
typescript.command_correction: No typecheck package script exists; corrected invocation is above.

verification.guards: Normal mandatory commit hooks: EE import, migration, template, package, related tests and TypeScript. Final outcome recorded in the PR description.
verification.manual_live_provider: not_run; no production flag change, paid models, real desktop notifications or external messages

limitations: Default off. Local fixtures verify backend delivery, not a production rollout or visual redesign.
A WebSocket transport receipt is not a user-read/render acknowledgment. Existing duplicate/retry uncertainty retains the same stable ID.
Configured perception and suggestion preparation still operate. Quiet mode stops automatic agent research and interruption, not awareness capture or explicit workflows.
The Q13 preparation dependency is not included or modified. Preparation readiness remains independently governed.
Full repository CI is tracked on the new PR separately from local affected checks.
rollback: Unset JARVIS_BRIEF_QUIET_AWARENESS and restart. Keep captures, suggestions, outbox receipts, prepared opportunities and decisions. Legacy interruption/auto-research behavior returns.
